title: Autonomous Testing and the Future of Software Development - Will Wilson
summary: Will Wilson explains autonomous testing: using deterministic simulation and fuzzing, building on FoundationDB's approach, to test software continuously. It sets out the ideas behind his later company Antithesis.
why: HN recommends it as an excellent talk on generalizing deterministic simulation testing, and Antithesis hiring posts link it to explain the work.

quote.text: I would encourage you to listen to Will Wilson’s excellent talk on the subject of Autonomous Testing
